## Behavior and infrastructure

What changed and why? Link relevant decision/requirements; distinguish active behavior from experiments.

## Verification evidence

Commands actually executed, results, baseline failures and artifact links. Include production staging and relevant tests.

## Visual and performance evidence

Song/hash, seed, timestamps, view, grids, source refs, actual renderer and environment. State what you inspected and measured. Link before/after/diff and benchmark reports. Separate CPU/software results from GPU/device evidence; write “not run” when appropriate.

## Remaining limitations

Known gaps, unverified devices, exact follow-up actions, and any intentional baseline change with reviewer/reason.
